resource.name: AllResultsTriggersforPublicHealthReporting
resource.title: All-Results Trigger Codes for Public Health Reporting
resource.description: Composite trigger code grouping for the Phase 2 "all-results-reportable" carve-out in the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) layer. Contains laboratory observation test name value sets for the conditions for which a negative or absent lab result still triggers public-health reporting (screening-driven / surveillance-relevant conditions identified by CSTE). Implementing PlanDefinitions should filter %labResults by this grouping in a parallel branch that retains the date timebox guard but skips the negative-value exclusion gates. Composition is the union of the per-condition test value sets published in VSAC for the 54 conditions on the CSTE-provided list, scoped by Condition Code on the RCTC release's Lab Obs Test Name (S4) tab (53 of 54 conditions match — Nongonococcal Urethritis is diagnosis-driven and is handled by the existing diagnosis trigger path).
resource.purpose: Laboratory test names whose observations are reportable to public health regardless of result polarity (positive, negative, or indeterminate). Used by eCR PlanDefinitions to exempt selected lab results from the negative-value exclusion filter.
